messages:
alex_m: starting canary rollout for inference-gateway v2 -> 10% pods, feature flag `new-cache`=on. kicking off at 03:12 UTC

deploy-bot: Canary started: id=canary-1925, route=canary-10pct, rolling into nodes pool `g4-canary`

infra-bot: ALERT: increased 5xx rate observed on canary pods (pod/inference-gateway-2  -> OOMKilled, pod/inference-gateway-4 -> CrashLoopBackOff)

miguel_r: paging oncall, PD triggered (sev2). @oncall-bot can you page sara_k?

oncall-bot: Paging @sara_k (reason: canary 5xx/oom on inference-gateway). Escalation: 2m

sara_k: on it — joining. quick ask: did we drain any nodes as part of the rollout?

alex_m: no explicit drain in the rollout. we scheduled canary pods on the `g4-canary` nodepool; however earlier today infra ran a rolling drain to update kernel on 2 nodes in that pool (~02:50 UTC).

jing_w: seeing repeated evictions + liveness probe fails in logs. paste: ```
Liveness probe failed: HTTP probe failed with statuscode: 502
OOMKilled: signal 9
Killed process 1 (inference-gw) total-vm: 512000kB
```

miguel_r: HPA is also scaling aggressively on canary pods — config has target CPU=40% but our image autoscaling hook is misreporting CPU. suspect HPA misconfig with the sidecar metrics adapter.

alex_m: that matches — HPA fired `scale from 2 to 8` for canary svc at 03:14:12 which overwhelmed nodes during node drain, caused evictions and OOMs.

infra-bot: Node events: `kubelet evicted pod inference-gateway-4` and `kubelet has insufficient memory` on node g4-canary-3.

sara_k: impact assessment? any customer-facing errors?

alex_m: preliminary: 12% error rate increase on /v1/generate for ~2% of customers routed to EU region (canary nodes are in eu-west). latency up ~200ms for those requests. No billing anomalies reported.

jing_w: logs show feature flag `new-cache` causes higher memory pressure at cold start for this image variant. Only canary pods had the new flag enabled.

miguel_r: mitigation options: 1) flip feature flag off for canary, 2) scale down HPA targets / pause autoscaling, 3) roll back canary to previous image. We should pick quickest to restore.

sara_k: priority is customer impact -> minimize errors ASAP. Flip flag off for canary first, then roll back if errors persist. Call out kill-switch.

alex_m: executing: `redwood-ff toggle --env=canary --flag=new-cache --off`

deploy-bot: Feature flag update accepted. new-cache=false for canary. Propagation ~5-10s.

jing_w: watching logs... memory pressure clearing from new pods now. error rate dropping.

infra-bot: HPA still scaling because metrics backlog. Suggest pausing HPA: `kubectl annotate hpa inference-gateway pausescaling=true` or set replicas=2 manually.

miguel_r: setting replicas=2 now: `kubectl scale deploy/inference-gateway-canary --replicas=2 --namespace=prod-canary`

deploy-bot: Scale success. replicas now 2.

alex_m: error rate back to baseline ~1% over last 3m. latency reduced. Rolling rollback not required at this time.

sara_k: good. declaring incident as resolved-> mitigated for now. we still need root cause: combination of node drain + HPA misconfigured metrics + feature flag memory spike.

miguel_r: recording follow-ups: 1) revert HPA metrics adapter change, 2) add memory probe and resource requests for `new-cache` variant, 3) avoid draining canary pool during rollouts or coordinate maintenance window.

jing_w: opening a follow-up ticket: INFRA-3921 (assign infra + eng-runtime) with logs and kube events.

alex_m: oncall handoff: i'm handing to night-shift @miguel_r for monitoring until 04:00 UTC. please escalate if any regression.

miguel_r: taking handoff. I've set a 20m watch, will mute alerts not matching the canary id.

sara_k: short postmortem and customer-impact note to be drafted. customers who saw errors: org-1834, org-5542 — we should notify support to watch for tickets.

infra-bot: INCIDENT: mitigated (canary flag flipped, hpa scaled). Severity lowered to SEV3. Please follow up in INFRA-3921.

alex_m: thanks team. adding ops-runbook items: `do not drain canary nodepool during scheduled rollouts` and `feature flag memory smoke test`

miguel_r: acknowledged. I'll update the oncall doc and close the open PD incident after 1hr quiet. :thumbsup:
